motive.prompt: An old sea otter admiral with a tricorn-like felt hat, brass spyglass and a weathered blue coat.
motive.stil: Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook animal character of a fairy-tale kingdom, a regular guest at a medieval tavern gaming table: warm candlelight, rich textures, dark warm background with subtle damask pattern, gentle friendly expression with a clever twinkle, humorous but dignified, bust portrait facing the viewer, head and shoulders fully inside the image, centred with space around so it can be cropped to a circle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
motive.ohne: text, letters, readable numbers, watermark, border, frame, modern clothing, logos, real people, celebrities, playing-card layout, weapons pointed at the viewer

motive.prompt: Dark stained old oak table planks with fine straight grain, plank joints running horizontally, overall colour close to #2e2015.
motive.stil: Seamless tileable texture, painted in a soft painterly oil style, viewed exactly from straight above, perfectly flat and evenly lit with no light source, no shadows, no vignette, no perspective. Very low contrast and calm, so that playing cards and text placed on top stay clearly readable. The left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge without any visible seam. No objects, no text, no letters, no numbers.
motive.ohne: objects, cards, dice, cups, stains, knots larger than a coin, strong highlights, shadows, vignette, perspective, border, frame, text, watermark, visible seams, repeating eye-catching spots
